import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

# Noisy high-dimensional dataset
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples, n_features = 200, 20
X_clean = np.random.randn(n_samples, 5) @ np.random.randn(5, n_features)
X_noisy = X_clean + np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features) * 0.5

# Standardize the noisy data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_noisy)

# Apply PCA and determine optimal components using cumulative variance > 95%
pca = PCA()
pca.fit(X_scaled)
cum_var = np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
n_components = np.argmax(cum_var >= 0.95) + 1
print(f"Components for 95% variance: {n_components}")
print(f"Cumulative variance: {cum_var[:n_components].round(3)}")

# Transform and inverse transform to reconstruct denoised data
pca_optimal = PCA(n_components=n_components)
X_reduced = pca_optimal.fit_transform(X_scaled)
X_denoised = pca_optimal.inverse_transform(X_reduced)
X_denoised = scaler.inverse_transform(X_denoised)

# Compare using MSE
mse_noisy = mean_squared_error(X_clean, X_noisy)
mse_denoised = mean_squared_error(X_clean, X_denoised)
print(f"\nMSE (noisy vs clean): {mse_noisy:.4f}")
print(f"MSE (denoised vs clean): {mse_denoised:.4f}")
print(f"Noise reduction: {(1 - mse_denoised/mse_noisy)*100:.1f}%")
